name: CP-LOD (Coverage-Preserving Prefix LOD)
definition: A runtime selection method that traverses a factree on GPU to produce a leaf-only cut bounded by a capacity budget K, using Morton-strided subsampling to preserve visual coverage.
summary: CP-LOD is a GPU-based selection method that traverses a factree to produce a leaf-only cut bounded by a capacity budget, using Morton-strided subsampling to preserve visual coverage and resolution-invariant materialized sets.
